def transform(grid):
    # Extend diagonal rays of the repeated color(s) away from the outlined corner motif.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    points = [(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    # identify the diagonal line color: appears in an adjacent pair and a continuing diagonal
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for _,_,v in points)
    color=max(counts, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    # fill its diagonal, continuing in direction from the pair/diagonal
    coords=[(r,c) for r,c,v in points if v==color]
    dr=dc=1
    if len(coords)>=2:
        # diagonal direction among observed adjacent points
        a,b=coords[0],coords[1]
        if abs(a[0]-b[0])==1 and abs(a[1]-b[1])==1:
            dr=1 if b[0]>a[0] else -1; dc=1 if b[1]>a[1] else -1
    # extend from extreme endpoint along its direction
    r,c=max(coords, key=lambda p:p[0]*dr+p[1]*dc)
    while 0<=r+dr<len(out) and 0<=c+dc<len(out[0]):
        r+=dr;c+=dc;out[r][c]=color
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Extend each diagonal run in its observed direction to the grid edge.
    from collections import Counter
    bg=max(Counter(x for row in grid for x in row),key=lambda x:Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)[x])
    for color in set(x for row in grid for x in row if x!=bg):
        pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==color]
        best=None
        for r,c in pts:
            for dr in (-1,1):
                for dc in (-1,1):
                    if (r+dr,c+dc) in pts:
                        best=(r,c,dr,dc);break
                if best:break
            if best:break
        if best:
            r,c,dr,dc=best
            # walk to the end of this run, then extend
            while (r+dr,c+dc) in pts:r+=dr;c+=dc
            while 0<=r+dr<len(out) and 0<=c+dc<len(out[0]):
                r+=dr;c+=dc
                if out[r][c]==bg:out[r][c]=color
    return out
